fusions.name: Riveted Shove
fusions.desc: Drives your shell into the target, which deals 12 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 14% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The target is [Damped], its damage lowered, for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Lames
fusions.desc: Blasts the outer plates off your shell, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores their armour.

fusions.name: Second Skin of Steel
fusions.desc: Closes a second layer of plate over you that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Layer on Layer
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
